SWA.input: Immediate value returned by SlidingWindowAttention.forward, after internal o_proj. AGTBlock norm/injection precedes the core, not the mixer.

GQA.input: Immediate tensor returned by GQA.forward, after its internal output projection.

GDN.input: The y component returned by GDNv3.forward; gated, per-head-normalized and o_proj-projected core output. Ephemeral recurrent state is not the mixer input.

FFN.input: Immediate output of SwiGLU within FFNHeavyCore, after sublayer pre-norm and before addition of the raw residual. Not the output of the complete FFNHeavyCore.

all.output: Actual scaled mHC output before raw residual addition; no unmixing.
all.invocations: 8 active mixers * 32 tokens; prelude mixer unused. Terminal contextual commits do not invoke these mixers.
all.hook_semantics: Forward hooks return None; copy detached args[0] and result after MHC.forward; no replacement or in-place operation.
